next_round.selection_is_a_dead_lever: Field evidence collected 2026-09-23 (docs/intel-2026-09-23.md, 'How the high scores select'): in this family selection = a ranker over the TTT candidate pool; attempt_1/attempt_2 are the top two of ONE ranking (score_kgmon by default, consensus count minus mean re-encoding score). The strongest public team in the family reports multiple alternative rankers helping CV only, a second decoding round with different seeds not moving the score, NLL thresholds being noise, and TRM candidates in the pool failing. Their measured wins were speed (largest-puzzles-first) and attribution (batch-invariant ops + cached adapters). Outside the family (55-83) no selection code is public; ARC-AGI-3 has no selection step at all (score = levels completed by an agent).
